_doc: Deployment options + ROI calculator inputs. Per docs/A2Z_LIVING_DOCS_PLAN.md Part 3 Rule 1, ROI projections are explicitly distinguished from measured outcomes.

cloud_managed.notes: Multi-tenant SaaS deployment is roadmap; v8.x is single-process Streamlit suitable for development/pilot environments.

on_premise.notes: Single-process Streamlit deployment is the canonical v8.x deployment pattern. Banks run on their own infrastructure with their own FLEXCUBE.
on_premise.compute_requirements_estimate: 1 CPU + 4GB RAM minimum; 2 CPU + 8GB RAM recommended for full registry load (per loader self-test timings).

hybrid.notes: Connected to bank-hosted FLEXCUBE via VPN/private link; A2Z runs on-premise.

roi_methodology_disclaimers.principle: All ROI numbers in collateral must be either MEASURED (from a real A2Z deployment) or PROJECTED (from a defined methodology with stated assumptions). Mixing them is forbidden.
projection_basis_examples: Industry research from published reports (e.g. McKinsey, Deloitte, Gartner) cited with date + URL
Bank-specific baseline measurements taken before A2Z deployment
Comparable-fintech outcomes (e.g. Zanifu) explicitly labelled as cited research

roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.design_addresses: Auto-cascade KPIs from board to teller (35 KPI library); engine + cascade shipped
roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.projection_methodology_required: Bank-specific baseline of current KPI achievement rate; A2Z deployment outcome measurement at 6-month and 12-month points

roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.design_addresses: FLEXCUBE downtime cushioning via retry + circuit breaker; ACL chain falls through to CBS-synthetic when live tier degraded
roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.projection_methodology_required: Pre/post measurement of platform uptime correlated with FLEXCUBE incidents

roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.design_addresses: 6-gate defense-in-depth perimeter; per-batch CHANGELOGs; tamper-evident audit trail
roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.projection_methodology_required: Pre/post measurement of audit-pack assembly time

roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.design_addresses: L14 channel reliability → smart alerts; tier classification (URGENT/HIGH/INFO) with alternative-channel guidance
roi_categories_addressed_at_design_level.projection_methodology_required: Customer-satisfaction measurement during/after channel-incident events; baseline + post-deployment comparison

honest_scope: A2Z has no measured ROI outcomes from production deployments. Any number framed as 'achievable ROI' is a projection, not a measurement.
Pricing model (per-bank licence, per-user, per-transaction) is not yet defined and must NOT appear in collateral as a fixed figure.
The 'numbers like 23% → 85%' from the original draft are removed because they have no methodology source.
ROI commitments to prospects must be made with explicit pre/post measurement methodology + bank-specific baselines, not generic claims.
